STRIKEOUT (K) TARGET

Strikeout leader: Chris Sale 6.2 K — Best Line: O 5+

ATL vs BOS V28. Paul Skenes 6.2 K (O 5+) is slate #2. Rule: ≥5 K → O5+, 4.5–4.99 → O3.5, <4.5 → O2.5. Never alt above 5 strikeouts.

Oriole Park -21% HR (TOR @ BAL) / PNC Park -18% HR (CHC @ PIT) / Fenway Park -18% HR (ATL @ BOS). Fade HR alts — pivot to 1+H / RBI / Runs plays.

park-board:
Sourced from Park_Factors sheet (stadium baseline + day-of weather). Sutter Health Park +29% HR is the slate's clear HR volcano (STL@ATH 9:40 ET). Rate Field +18% (KC@CHW) is the secondary HR booster. Only 3 parks above +5% HR: Sutter, Rate, Great American (+8%). Fenway / Truist / Citi / PNC all suppressed -14% to -23% HR. Fenway +18% 2B/3B and PNC +13% 2B/3B = doubles plays in those parks instead.
